contract: The gateway's public answer for a hosted provider's approval, GET /public/v3/providers/:agentId/approval (no authentication; Cache-Control: public, max-age=10), before and after the provider was approved. Synthetic: example hosts, label-derived wallets, a fixed approval time. Added by the gateway.
consumers: hosted provider runtimes that check approval records
rules: approved is true only while the gateway sells the provider through its approval record: the provider holds a current approval on the gateway's chain, approvals are on for the record's origin, and no servicing admission or manifest profile names a control profile for the provider. Otherwise approved is false, with no other field.

record is the ProviderControlProfileV1 envelope the gateway built when it approved the provider and stored; signerKeyId is gateway-approval-v1, issuedAt and validBefore are 0 and signature is 0x: it is never signed.

recordHash is the canonical hash of record exactly as served (canonicalHash in src/standardRail/canonical.ts: keys sorted, no whitespace, keccak256), signature included. It is the providerControlProfileHash the gateway's dispatches carry for the provider.

environment, chainId and audience are those the gateway's manifest profiles carry. providerAudience, origin and the six URLs are the provider card's standard-rail values as the gateway stored them; assetResponseKey is the registration's agent wallet, checksummed; servicingProfileEpoch is one more than the highest epoch of the provider's manifest profiles and earlier approval records, else 1, and never names two records.
approvedAt is when the current approval was made (ISO 8601).
